answer: Your records don't list any allergies. There is no allergy or intolerance entry at all, in any of the three record pulls (February 2024, February 2025, October 2026). That is not the same as a confirmed 'no known allergies': nothing in the records says allergies were asked about and found to be none. So I can't tell you that you have none. If you know of a reaction to a medicine, food or contrast dye, tell your doctor so it gets recorded. You did have contrast for a chest CT in July 2025, and nothing about a reaction was noted, but the records are silent on that either way.
